description_en: Nugaḥ Sataḥ 1 stands behind Lakṣmīnārāyaṇa Sataḥ (LAL4044) in Nugaḥ Ṭola, facing south. There is no evidence as per inscription to date the initial construction of the Sataḥ. It was constructed as a residence for the household ascetics (Kapālī-jogīs). They used to make their living by sewing clothes. Following the death of all the family members of the previous residents, the Sataḥ was abandoned. In 2000 CE (VS 2057), Prabhat Red Star Club, a local club based in Nugaḥ, raised funds for its repair and reconstruction. The original timber posts, windows, and other materials were reused as much as possible in this initiative. There are no statues in the Sataḥ, and no more social or cultural events are taking place. As of today, the club rents the place out to as a café to generate income.
description_ne: नुग: टोलमा रहेको लक्ष्मीनारायण सत: (LAL4044)को पछाडि जोडिएर यो सत: निर्माण गरिएको छ । पश्चिमाभिमुख गरी बनाइएको यो सत: कसले र कहिले निर्माण गरेको भन्ने कुरा जानकारी दिने कुनै अभिलेख पाइँदैन । यो सत: जुगी (कपाली) हरू बस्नको लागि बनाइएको थियो । ती कपालीहरू लुगा सिउने काम गर्थे । पछि सत:मा बसोबास गरिरहेका कपाली परिवारका सबै सदस्यहरूको मृत्यु भएपछि सत: बेवारिसे अवस्थामा पुगेको थियो । विसं २०५७ (सन् २०००) तिर नुग: टोलमा रहेको प्रभात रेड स्टार क्लबले विभिन्न स्रोतहरूबाट चन्दा उठाएर सत:को पुनर्निर्माण गरेको थियो । पुनर्निर्माण गर्दा सकेसम्म पुरानै काठका झ्याल, खम्बाहरूको प्रयोग गरिएको थियो । यहाँ कुनै मूर्ति पनि छैन र कुनै धार्मिक-सांस्कृतिक गतिविधि पनि गरिँदैन । अहिले सत:मा क्याफे सञ्चालन गरिएको छ । क्याफेको भाडा प्रभात रेड स्टार क्लबले नै उठाउने गरेको छ ।
brick_type: mā apā (regular fired brick), dāci apā (conical veneer brick)
monument_assessment: Slightly damaged (minor damages such as minor cracks, plants, missing stones in plinths)
references: Sources and references Sources Local knowledge: An advisor of Sundhārā Ṭola Sudhāra Samiti from a Jośī caste, male, age 78

historical_events.event_description: It was abandoned, following the death of all the members of the Kapālī family living in Sataḥ. The local Prabhat Red Star Club invested in the Sataḥ's reconstruction by raising funds from various sources.
